comparison.objective: Candidate sorts cartons on a conveyor by physical flap state; PR-1930 replaces two shelf-edge price tickets while preserving a third.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests dynamic tracking and body support around articulated obstacles. PR-1930 tests opening a sprung strip, extracting and inserting thin cards, and precise seating.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate grades open-carton rejection, content retention and untouched closed-carton passage. PR-1930 grades old-ticket disposal, correct new-ticket placement, closed strip, undisturbed control ticket and cans, release and dwell.
comparison.reason: Both are selective interventions, but the decisive abilities—moving loaded-carton handling versus thin-card extraction/insertion—are materially different. No material rubric detail is missing.
